entities.name: PMID:27506483
observations: Retrospective, single-institution series of 16 peripapillary retinoschisis eyes; EDI-OCT found abnormal lamina cribrosa in all included eyes (8 glaucoma, 8 pachychoroid-spectrum).

entities.name: PMID:35047360
observations: Retrospective cross-sectional study of 180 pachychoroid disease spectrum patients and 236 controls; compared focal lamina cribrosa defect prevalence.

entities.name: LC-retinoschisis case-series finding
observations: In 16 selected retinoschisis eyes with abnormal EDI-OCT lamina cribrosa, 8 had glaucoma and 8 pachychoroid-spectrum disease; central defects tracked inner-layer schisis, while disinsertions/peripheral defects tracked outer-layer schisis. Case series shows co-occurrence, not causation or prevalence.

entities.name: Pachychoroid LC cohort finding
observations: In pachychoroid without peripapillary retinoschisis, focal LC defects occurred in 6/180 (3.3%) versus 0/236 controls; difference was not statistically significant (P=0.318), showing LC defects can occur independently of retinoschisis.
